text: Hello, everyone.It's great to meet you another time.Today, we'll move on to the sixth period of this unit.We're going to read a book review of The Great Gatsby.By the end of this period, you are expected to identify and master the layout, content, and language features of a book review.You are also expected to write a book review of a fiction book with the right layout and proper language.Before we start, make sure you have the textbook and the worksheet.Please open your books to page 82.Yesterday, I went to the school library.I found a book titled The Great Gatsby.I have no idea of it.Fortunately, there is a book review.Let's take a look.Read the sample book review and figure out the layout and the main idea.You are given three minutes.What can you find about The Great Gatsby from paragraph 1?As you can see in the slide, in paragraph 1, the author, the type of literature, and the title are mentioned.So paragraph 1 is what we call an introduction to the book.The author F.Scott Fitzroth was an American author of novels and short stories.He is widely regarded as one of the greatest American writers of the 20th century.Now let's come to paragraph 2.After introducing the general information of the book, characters and the main themes are discussedso that readers can form a concise summary of the plot.This book is about Jay Gatsby who loves Dazing.The story is told by Dazing's cousin Nick.Gatsby loves Dazing so much that he spares no effort to attract Dazing's attention.In doing so, Dazing, a woman with a husband, does come into Gatsby's life, but with a tragic ending.In Nick's narration, some ugly truths about love, wealth, and money are revealed.How about the remaining paragraphs?Paragraph 3 deals with the highlights of the book.That's why the reviewer wants to recommend it.The main characters' complicated personalities are appealing.Dazing is vulnerable and charming, but at the same time, so are the main characters.However, Gatsby, a liar, has morality unmatched by the characters who grew up with money.The last paragraph is the conclusion.In paragraph 4, the book reviewer emphasizes the reason why he wants to recommend the book to readers.The great Gatsby points out that Dazing is a man who loves money.The reviewer emphasizes the reason why he wants to recommend the book to readers.The great Gatsby portrays a fascinating time in American history, and the story is told in details.In this case, the reviewer uses expressive words like perceptive, fascinating, gripping, moving, expressive, and precise to illustrate his enthusiasm for the book.How do you understand the word gripping?Yes, here gripping means exciting or interesting.After reading the book review, I have realized that F.Scott Fitzgerald described Gatsby's passion and pursuit for Dazing in order to review some ugly truths about love, wealth, and the soul of American life.With the help of the book review, I am entirely fascinated with the great Gatsby and want to enjoy it.How about you?I have heard that next week there will be a reading festival in our school.Each student is expected to recommend his or her favorite book to the other students.Which book do you want to recommend?How can you make a recommendation?Right, by writing a book review.Now, let's go over the layout of a book review.Can you tell me how to write a book review?Let's go.Paragraph 1 is an introduction to the book, covering the title, author, and type of literature.Paragraph 2 is a concise summary of the plot, including the main scenes and characters.Paragraph 3 is highlights of the book.The last paragraph concludes why the reviewer wants to recommend the book.Yes, you have got a clear picture of the layout and content of a book review.And remember to use expressive language.Let's go to the book review.You have got a clear picture of the layout and content of a book review.Let's apply theory to practice.Due to time limit, we will deal with the first two paragraphs during the class.Write an introduction to the book and a summary of the plot by imitating the sample.These fiction books are for your reference.You are given five minutes.你完成了写作吗?现在,让我们测试两个例子。第一个是苏森写的。苏森,你会先读一下吗?苏森写的《黑暗的天空》,就是我们的梦想。苏森写的母亲的经典诗,《月亮和六尺的梦》,根据《法国印象画家》的导师Pol Gauguin的生活。这本书专门关于Streetland,一个普通的网易购买者。在这本书专门,他突然发现了艺术,然后他愿意追求梦想。除了他的妻子和孩子之外,除了他的前妻子和孩子之外,最后,他把自己的妻子描绘成了色彩的画面。这故事展示了心灵和精神的生命,现实和梦想,这依然是我们讨论的。非常好,苏森。你提到写作者、类型和名字在第一个词中。在第二个词中,你谈论了角色和主题。除此之外,你使用了独特的语言,例如《愿意》和《似乎》的语言,这将提升了写作的色彩。然而,你遇到的一个角色是斯丘夫,他在逛街上谈论了Streetland。他在街上谈论了Streetland。加他在你的描绘的总结中,让它成功。这里来自LUCY's TUNE。LUCY,请与我们分享你的写作。《逃亡的政府》是在1870年发布的Mark Twain。Mark Twain,一个美国语人和设计师,写了很多有趣的作品,包括《一百万磅的记录》,《汤苏威尔的冒险》,等等。《逃亡的政府》的主题是关于他逃亡的经历。写者明显地展示了他的暗面给读者。Mark Twain被他的政治对手试图了许多犯罪,因为他有一个很好的性格。Rudy Crouse和Liz Chard说,他们仍然在媒体上发布。他们试图在这种方式破坏了他的政治专业。经历了一段长时间的谎言,他感到生气。最后,他必须辞职。LUCY,你不仅说了名字和作品的主题,但也给读者介绍了作品。从你的写作,读者可以知道Mark Twain的有名作品,例如《一百万磅的记录》和《汤苏威尔的冒险》。你谈论了主题和作品的主题。《逃亡为政府》谈论了Mark Twain逃亡为政府的经历,让读者想象到政治圈的暗面。你把读者描述为Ludicruz。Ludicruz是否意味着理性?是的,它意味着不理性。这是一个非常表达性的语言,展示了冒险是多么的愚蠢。然而,你也应该把写字的类型描述成1,以完成你的评论。Susan和Lucy都做了一个很棒的工作。我期待看到你的作品。你将在第一个课中介绍的主题和作品的组织和总结,以帮助检测清单。你将在第一个课中介绍的主题、主题、和第一个课中介绍的主题和主题的类型。你将在第二个课中介绍的主题和主题中介绍的主题和主题。你将在第二个课中介绍的主题中介绍的主题。现在是你的提问。完成了你本的评论,以约120个字,以适合的类型和语言。感谢您的观看。
